articles.summary: Accra, Ghana – March 11, 2025: Flutterwave, Africa’s leading payments technology company, has announced its approval to provide inward remittance services to Ghana, granted recently by the Bank of Ghana. This development further solidifies Flutterwave’s commitment to simplifying payments for endless possibilities across Africa. articles.title: Flutterwave Strengthens Ghana Operations with Key Remittance Service Approval
